resources.string: OpenPressure has not been tested with this monitor yet. A device report shows how it communicates and can help unlock more features for it in the app.

OpenPressure has not been tested with this monitor yet. It would help a lot if you shared a device report in a GitHub issue. Your report and your help can unlock more features for your monitor in the app.\n\nThe report contains only technical details. It never includes readings, measurement times, names, the Bluetooth address or the serial number. You can review it before you share anything.
Check the report below. “%1$s” copies it and opens a prepared issue form; paste the report there. Nothing is sent automatically.
